command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
cd /tmp
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl
printf 'd685517ba79cf79617cdb11c63fb458fbc9f1a020f3e7b25e2804c8a6f0db8ec  run.sh\n6408004f3517e0a7e6e61b5208096a52c4ce5685d7c1f30033c890944d4d5dca  gwreal.py\nfe3719dfdf4e8112845aa4be859f170d19f6fffa5440253ba17c61aff817aa05  search.py\n4eb80e0cc25f3eba6eff61e6d1bcf1ac4ed7331b260dd24fb00b0737f34249ff  pe.py\n67e7a24fd9d68cc038dfa7c1f2520b00449970aa08e67cae59506bd13b35c2a8  inputs.sha256\n' > scripts.sha256
sha256sum -c scripts.sha256 || { echo 'FAIL: a staged script does not match its pin'; exit 1; }
grep -E '  (H-H1_LOSC_16_V1-1126256640-4096\.hdf5|L-L1_LOSC_16_V1-1126256640-4096\.hdf5|IGWN-GWTC2p1-v2-GW150914_095045_PEDataRelease_mixed_nocosmo\.h5|H-H1_LOSC_4_V1-1126256640-4096\.hdf5|L-L1_LOSC_4_V1-1126256640-4096\.hdf5)$' inputs.sha256 | sed 's|  |  data/|' > data.sha256
test "$(wc -l < data.sha256)" = 5 || { echo 'FAIL: pins missing'; exit 1; }
sha256sum -c data.sha256 || { echo 'FAIL: staged data does not match inputs.sha256'; exit 1; }
bash /tmp/run.sh 64 500
